snippet.title: Dumpster Gang - Official Reveal Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
If you've ever wanted to play as a mischievous raccoon with your friends, Dumpster Gang needs to be added to your list. 


This chaotic co-op sandbox game lets up to four players live their ""best raccoon lives - scavenging dumpsters, stealing junk, raiding snacks, committing tiny crimes, and avoiding the clutches of the evil exterminator." You'll also need to haul loot, solve puzzles, help your friends, and customize your hideout with all the junk / treasure you've collected!


Dumpster Gang will be released on Steam, Xbox on PC, and PC Game Pass in December 2026.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
